changelog:
• Pass exact yt-dlp format_id pairs from the selected format preset
• Disable the NewPipe progressive-video shortcut so selected quality is respected
• Verify bundled FFmpeg binary and extracted support files before merging
• Prevent yt-dlp config from overriding the selected format_id
• Fix notification title visibility in light and dark system themes
• Fix Android 12+ custom download notification rendering
• Show thumbnail, title and progress in custom notification views
• Remove unconstrained low-quality yt-dlp format fallback
• Prioritize requested resolution during video/audio stream selection
• Keep bundled FFmpeg initialization before stream merging
• Separate JET Debug in-app update channel
• Consistently signed Debug APK for future in-app updates
• Prefer size-bearing HTTPS video streams over HLS manifests
• Add IPv4 and retry options for yt-dlp downloads
• Show live APK download percentage in the in-app updater
• Add bitrate-based video preset size fallbacks
• Keep format-sheet size estimates on fast NewPipe metadata and local bitrate fallbacks
• Select best MP4 video and M4A audio dynamically by requested resolution
• Initialize bundled FFmpeg before YoutubeDL and preserve wrapper-managed FFmpeg paths
• Prefer Android/iOS YouTube clients for extraction
• Use the yt-dlp nightly update channel for current YouTube fixes
• Keep the installed engine usable when an engine update fails
• Show video thumbnails in the format sheet, Downloads and Library
• Persist thumbnail URLs with download records
• Add foreground download progress and completion notifications
